offering_description.value: Develops and sells life science reagents, antibodies, assays, instruments and diagnostic tests for research and clinical use. It sells to academic, pharmaceutical, biotech and clinical laboratory customers, mainly through direct sales, distributors and online ordering, and makes most products in its own facilities.

primary_products.value: research reagents and antibodies; ELISA and immunoassay kits; spatial biology instruments and assays; diagnostic tests; cell culture media

primary_services.value: custom antibody and reagent development; genomic testing services; technical support

customer_segment.value: B2B: pharmaceutical and biotech companies, academic research labs, clinical laboratories; B2G: government research institutes and public research hospitals

end_markets.value: life sciences research; biopharmaceuticals; clinical diagnostics

revenue_model.value: product sales: reagents, antibodies, kits, instruments and consumables sold to research and clinical customers; service fees: custom development, testing and support services; licensing or royalties: licensed diagnostic and assay technologies
revenue_model.category: product sales; service fees; licensing or royalties

value_chain_position.value: OEM / manufacturer: makes reagents, antibodies and instruments from raw biological and chemical materials, sold to labs and pharma; brand owner: sells its own branded research and diagnostic products through its own channels; service provider: provides testing and custom development services to pharma and clinical customers
value_chain_position.category: OEM / manufacturer; brand owner; service provider

geography_served.value: global: North America, Europe, China, Japan and other international markets

specialization.value: related lines: protein sciences reagents, spatial biology, and diagnostics and genomics, sharing life science research customers

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: sales teams selling to pharma, biotech and research institutions; distributors / dealers: third-party distributors in regions outside its direct coverage; online: online catalog and e-commerce ordering for research products

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: clinical diagnostics and genomic testing under CLIA and FDA rules, research products largely under general quality standards
